text_block_list.text:
Shinko Windy claims first place,<n>forcing everyone in
the venue to<n>acknowledge her talent as genuine.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Following the race, she becomes a<n>red-hot topic. It
won't be long now<n>before she can finally pull off
her<n>ultimate prank!
